question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-665 (Exploitation of Thunderbolt Protection Flaws) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 4 record(s) from 2 source(s); 3 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-665 maps to the ATT&CK techniques T1211 (Exploitation for Stealth), T1542.002 (Component Firmware), and T1556 (Modify Authentication Process). T1542.002 can be mitigated by Update Software (M1051), while T1211 can be addressed with options like Update Software (M1051) and Exploit Protection (M1050). T1556 is associated with several mitigations including Audit (M1047), Multi-factor Authentication (M1032), and various account and permission management controls.

records.name: Exploitation of Thunderbolt Protection Flaws
records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: An adversary leverages a firmware weakness within the Thunderbolt protocol, on a computing device to manipulate Thunderbolt controller firmware in order to exploit vulnerabilities in the implementation of authorization and verification schemes within Thunderbolt protection mechanisms. Upon gaining physical access to a target device, the adversary conducts high-level firmware manipulation of the victim Thunderbolt controller SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) flash, through the use of a SPI Programing device and an external Thunderbolt device, typically as the target device is booting up.
